title: Father's Legacy
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment Chen Ji tucked the journal into his chest, the fifth layer seal of the Tianji Record cracked open with a thunderous sound, and an unprecedented power surged from the depths of his bloodline— it was the Chen Family Secret Art that had slumbered for ten thousand years, slowly awakening with his will.

text.content: The voice seemed to traverse endless years, carrying a familiar warmth yet threaded with undeniable weariness. Chen Ji stood rooted, his body rigid, fingertips trembling slightly. This was his father's voice—the one who vanished when he was seven, whom he believed had long turned to dust, now resonating here in this moment. He drew a sharp breath, following the faint pull toward the deepest part of the ruins. Each step felt like treading on fragments of memory, his heartbeat growing ever clearer in the silence.

At the end of the corridor stood an ancient stone door, covered in symbols Chen Ji had never seen before. Those symbols created a subtle resonance with the Tianji Record within him, as if waiting for something. He extended his right hand, palm pressing against the stone door— a warm force surged from the depths of his bloodline, the symbols blazed brilliantly, and the stone door slid open silently. Beyond was a modest stone chamber, its walls covered in dense text and patterns, and at the chamber's center, a yellowed jade slip hovered suspended in midair.

dialogue.content: "You've arrived." The aged voice sounded again, but this time it didn't come from beyond his Mental Sea— it flowed forth slowly from within the jade slip. "I have waited for this day far too long."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the jade slip, his eyes growing warm. He recognized this voice— it was his father, the memory fragments he had desperately tried to grasp through countless sleepless nights. He didn't immediately step forward, but stood there, voice hoarse: "Are you... still alive?" A soft sigh came from within the jade slip: "My physical body has long returned to dust. This is merely a wisp of remnant consciousness, waiting for you at this final place of inheritance."

choice.prompt: Facing his father's last remnant consciousness, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Suppress emotions, first inquire key information
choices.description: Chen Ji quickly gathered his emotions, forcing himself to face things rationally— since his father had arranged all this, there must be something important to convey.
choices.visible_cost: The inner ache brought by emotional suppression
choices.visible_reward: An opportunity to obtain complete information
choices.risk_hint: The possibility of missing the chance for a final heart-to-heart with his father

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, forcefully pressing down the churning emotions. He knew his father was not someone who did meaningless things— since he had arranged all this even at the end of his life, there must be crucial information. He opened his eyes, voice still trembling but as steady as possible: "Father, the origin of the Tianji Record... and what you called 'the method to break the chess game'— what exactly are they?"

choices.text: Drop the mask, release suppressed emotions
choices.description: For seventeen years, he had been playing the role of that indifferenttrash. Now facing his father's remnant consciousness, he finally allowed himself to be vulnerable once.
choices.visible_cost: A brief loss of emotional control
choices.visible_reward: Complete a true farewell with his father
choices.risk_hint: It might seem weak, but this is an important moment in the character's arc

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, his knees striking the cold stone floor heavily. He didn't speak, only pressing his forehead before the jade slip, shoulders shaking silently. Tears slipped from his tightly closed eyes, spreading into a dark stain on the stone floor. Seventeen years of pretense, seventeen years of endurance, seventeen years of loneliness— all broke free at this moment. The voice in the jade slip fell silent for a moment, then a very soft sigh came: "Good child... no, you have already grown up."

The jade slip slowly unfurled, countless specks of light drifting out, constructing illusory images before Chen Ji's eyes. That was the history of the Chen family— the true origin of the Tianji Record. Ten thousand years ago, the Chen family's ancestor was not an ordinary cultivator, but a being born from the same source as the Heavenly Dao's Eye. He chose another path: using his own strength to weave a web of fate, opposing that lofty will of the Heavenly Dao. The Tianji Record was the sole fruit borne from that path.

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye views all seers as chess pieces," the voice within the jade slip was low and solemn. "But there is always one thing it cannot find— the bloodline of the Chen family. Ten thousand years ago, our ancestor fused his purest Dao seed into the bloodline. Since then, our clan has become the 'blind spot' of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. It cannot see us, so it needs the Tianji Record to peer into heavenly secrets...可笑的是，这窥探天机的能力，本就是它想用来控制我们的枷锁。"

text.content: Chen Ji stared at those light and shadow interweaving images, his heart churning with indescribable emotions. So that was it— the reason he could foresee the future without detection by the Heavenly Dao's Eye was not coincidence, but a fate already written into his bloodline. He understood even more why his father had concealed everything, why he had been forced to hide his abilities since childhood. "Father, you... have been protecting me from the very beginning." His voice was so low it was almost inaudible.

choice.prompt: Facing everything his father had done for him, how will Chen Ji choose his next path?

choices.text: Inherit his father's legacy, confront the Heavenly Dao directly
choices.description: Since his bloodline was born as the natural nemesis of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, there is no reason for any retreat— this path, he will walk it to the end.
choices.visible_cost: Will inevitably face the full suppression of the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Obtained the complete ancestral inheritance, the Tianji Record's seal further released
choices.risk_hint: The path ahead is perilous, unknown enemies are watching from the shadows

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose, wiping away the tears at the corners of his eyes, his gaze gradually becoming resolute and sharp. He stared directly at the Jade Slip, his voice low yet resonant: "Father, I understand. Since the Heavenly Eye wishes to use me as a chess piece, I will overturn this chessboard." The Jade Slip suddenly emitted a brilliant light, that was recognition, expectation, and an inheritance spanning across time and space.

choices.description: The enemy of one's enemy may not be a friend; rash exposure will only bring greater misfortune—first clarify all the truth.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may have already sensed the abnormality

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing the surging emotions to the deepest part of his heart. He knew that getting carried away by passion was never his style. "Father, I need more time." His voice returned to its usual calm, "Tell me, what else must I know—about the Heavenly Eye, about Ling Yuan, about... Nian." When he spoke his sister's name, his eyes trembled slightly, that was the only variable he could not completely control.

The light in the Jade Slip dimmed slightly, Father's voice becoming increasingly ethereal: "Time is running out... this remnant consciousness cannot sustain much longer. Remember, after the fifth layer of the Tianji Record, there are layers six and seven... each corresponding to a lost Chen family secret technique. As for Ling Yuan..." The voice paused, "He discovered the secrets of the Tianji Record before me, but his bloodline is not pure enough to truly master it. That's why he wants to use your hand... be wary of him."

dialogue.content: "And your sister," Father's voice suddenly became infinitely gentle, "Nian is the Heavenly Fate Key. Her destiny will disrupt all foresight—including the Tianji Record. Her being taken by the Holy Sect was part of my arrangement. Only at a specific moment can she play her greatest role." Chen Ji's fists unconsciously tightened. Even Nian was calculated by his father... but he knew this might be the only way his father could protect them.

text.content: The Jade Slip began slowly fragmenting, countless specks of light scattering like fireflies. Father's voice grew increasingly faint: "Child... I cannot walk this path with you, but I've left everything to you. The journal contains the Chen family's ten-thousand-year accumulation of secrets... and a list of those... secretly opposing the Heavenly Eye. They are scattered across the three major sects, the Demonic Path, even the Heavenly Alliance... find them."

choice.prompt: This is the final opportunity to bid farewell to his father, what would Chen Ji want to say to his father?

choices.text: Make a vow, live up to the trust
choices.description: This is Father's final entrustment, he will not let Father's sacrifice be in vain—the glory of the Chen family, he will restore.
choices.visible_reward: Receive Father's blessing and a temporary buff blessed by it
choices.risk_hint: The heavier the promise, the heavier the responsibility

text.content: Chen Ji knelt on both knees, performing the most formal bow to the gradually dissipating light. His forehead touched the ground, his voice steady and resolute: "Father, your son Chen Ji, hereby swears—to break the Heavenly Chess Game, to find Nian, to restore the Chen family's glory to the world. Even if I must shatter into pieces, I shall have no regrets." As the words fell, the Jade Slip transformed into countless light specks, like a meteor shower falling into his body, warm and familiar.

choices.text: Only want to say a word of missing
choices.description: Seventeen years have passed, he has too many words to say but doesn't know where to begin—at this moment, he just wants to be that child who lost his father.
choices.visible_cost: May let Father pass away with regrets
choices.visible_reward: Release the long-held burden, make peace with the past
choices.risk_hint: Emotional vulnerability may affect subsequent judgment

text.content: "Father..." Chen Ji's voice choked, those carefully constructed words all crumbling into nothingness, leaving only the simplest, purest two characters, "I miss you." A soft laugh came from the jade slip, that laugh held no regrets, only contentment and tenderness. The light particles swirled and gathered beside him, transforming into an illusory hand, gently brushing across his hair—that was his father's final caress.

The light particles gradually faded away, the stone chamber returned to silence. Chen Ji knelt alone on the spot, surrounded by walls covered in text he had never seen before—those were the complete manuscripts his father had left using his final心血. He slowly stood up, tucking the jade slip that had lost its glow into his chest, a last trace of warmth still lingering within. He began reading the text on the walls, and the more he read, the more alarmed he became: so the Tianji Record contained nine layers, and he had only touched the edge of the fourth layer.

The manuscripts detailed the research achievements of Chen family ancestors through generations, along with methodologies for confronting the Heavenly Mandate's Eye. One passage he read repeatedly three times: "The fifth layer secret technique is called 'Heavenly Fate Rewriting', capable of briefly altering the predetermined trajectory of fate. However, casting this technique requires the caster to sacrifice ten years of lifespan, and after casting, one will surely suffer heavenly backlash—minor injuries at best, severe at worst..." The following words were blurred by water stains, completely illegible. Chen Ji stared at that残缺的 passage, suddenly gave a light smile— what his father had施展 back then, was probably this very technique.

The moment Chen Ji tucked the manuscripts into his chest, an intense tremor suddenly echoed from the depths of his Mental Sea. The fifth layer seal of the Tianji Record—that barrier he had believed impenetrable, now displayed a tiny crack. Immediately after, a vast and ancient power surged from the depths of his bloodline, like a slumbering beast that had slept for ten thousand years finally opening its eyes. That was the gift left by Chen family ancestors, the sign of bloodline awakening, and furthermore... the first step of destiny's gear beginning to turn.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, sensing that unprecedented power within his body. It blended perfectly with the Tianji Record, yet maintained its own independent will. He opened his eyes, a flash of brilliant light in his gaze—in that instant, he glimpsed fragments within the next hour: Ling Yuan standing in the Tianqing Sect Grand Hall, a secret letter in hand, a meaningful smile on his face; far away in the Holy Sect's depths, Nian Nian imprisoned in some forbidden grounds, her eyes flickering with sorrow unfitting her age; and above the heavens, a pair of invisible eyes slowly opening, seemingly searching for something—that blind spot it could never see through.

"Father," Chen Ji轻声说道, his voice echoing in the empty stone chamber, "I understand." He clutched the jade slip fragments in his chest even tighter, as if to eternally engrave that warmth into his palm. Then he turned, striding toward the stone door outside. Father's legacy he had tucked into his chest, father's dying wish he had engraved in his heart. From this moment, he was no longer thattrash servant Chen Ji— he was the last bloodline of the Chen family, the inheritor of the Tianji Record, the destined Chess Player who would overturn this heavenly chess game.
